Decision Over Chaos. 

Embracing Agentic AI 

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control. 

Unified detection and response across data sources 

AI-driven anomaly detection with context 

Pre-built content and playbooks 

The Result: Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent. 

SEE HOW 

Alerts to Action. 

Evolving to the Agentic SOC 

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex, teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time. 

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight. 

With Securonix: 

Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk 

Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance 

Strengthen breach readiness across the environment 

Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2 

SEE HOW 

Meet Sam 

The AI SOC Analyst 

Sam, t he AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior, understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response. Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided. 

With Sam: 

Automated alert triage and prioritization 

Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence 

Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting 

Case preparation for escalation and response 

Executive- and board-ready security summaries 

MEET SAM 

Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features 

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these capabilities as one coordinated system. 

Threat Intelligence That Drives Action 

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your environment. 

Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment 

MITRE ATT&CK aligned context 

Integrated ThreatQ capabilities 

EXPLORE THREAT INTELLIGENCE 

Trusted by Global Security Leaders 

Evolving to the Agentic SOC 

Enterprises and MSSPs rely on Securonix to modernize security operations, reduce operational risk, and move from reactive response to proactive, intelligence-driven defense. And there’s a reason for that: 

Six-Time Consecutive Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM 
Consistently recognized for completeness of vision and ability to execute, reflecting sustained innovation, architectural strength, and customer trust. 

Two-Time Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights™ 
Validated directly by security practitioners for product capabilities, deployment experience, and measurable operational value. 

Together, these recognitions reflect both strategic leadership and real-world impact for Enterprises and MSSPs.
